extraction.notes: Reconciliation starts at GAAP net income attributable to common stockholders ($7,059K) on page 8. NAREIT FFO $5,405K and AFFO $7,168K tie to the printed subtotals. Diluted FFO/AFFO share count of 18,928,648 is printed in full on page 9 and was divided by 1,000 to 18,928.648 thousand; per-share checks give $0.29 FFO and $0.38 AFFO, matching reported figures. Company reports no separate core FFO metric. Zero-valued current-quarter lines (gain on sale of real estate, loss on extinguishment of debt, JV insurance gain) are included as printed. The gain on insurance recovery (62) is categorized as casualty because it is an insurance recovery. Recurring capex of $208K (BRT share; $247K gross) is taken from the quarter-ended Capital Expenditures table on page 16 because AFFO does not subtract recurring capex. The "Equity in earnings from sale of unconsolidated JV properties" line is categorized as property_sale_gain_loss.
